# defect was a missing DMC transfer-start delay: a $4015 write that re-armed an
# idle channel requested its sample fetch immediately, so the fetch rode the
# write's 433-cycle cadence instead of the timer's 432 and the table came out
# Kept as the regression oracle. Re-measure with:
# ⚠ Not a gate. Nothing asserts against this file. The gate is
# sweep-baseline-v1.tsv, which declares both ROMs as passing.
# Ruled out along the way (each measured, each disproved) -- do not retry:
#   * OAM DMA alone -- 513/514 by alignment, correct
#   * DMC DMA alone -- 3/4 by alignment, correct
#   * combined stall with a sliding $4014 -- alternates 515/516, correct
#   * inverting the get/put phase to match Mesen's pre-increment evaluation --
#     the ROM then never settles at all
#   * the OAM transfer itself -- a cycle-by-cycle bus-op diff against Mesen2
